blocks.text: Far Eastern University overturned a one-set deficit to take down Emilio Aguinaldo College, 20-25, 25-13, 24-26, 25-12, 15-6, and complete a sweep of pool play in the 2026 Shakey's Super League (SSL) Unity Cup on Saturday at the Rizal Memorial Coliseum.
